name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Sour Apple Grape
description:
Get ready for a bold twist with Double-Stacked Sour Apple Grape gummies. Every 2-count bag brings 1,000mg per gummy, loaded with Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP for maximum impact. These dual-layer treats combine crisp, tart green apple with rich, tangy grape for a flavor profile that hits different. Perfect for those who crave intensity in both taste and potency. Add this powerhouse flavor to your rotation now!

Sour Apple Grape layers tart Apple with juicy Grape flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
